title: WorldFunder
tagline: Decentralized funding system for open source projects with communitiy voting mechanism.
description:
This project provides funding for open source projects in democratic manner using voting mechanism such that everyone's vote is worth the same. We verify that voters are real people in private and secure way. Projects can apply for funding and users can vote for projects they find most valuable and at the end funds are distributed to projects in proportion to their votes. 
There is a top donors leaderboard where donors are sorted by their donation sizes.
how_its_made:
Project is built using typescript and react. For web3 actions we used Wagmi. We used Tailwind CSS for design.

Project uses Worldcoin as a human verification method, which prevents malicious users from voting through many accounts. Projects can be accessed via their ENS domain. Users on leaderboard can also be mentioned by their ENS domain.
